name: WHO emergencies
summary: WHO's Ebola emergency of international concern, declared on 17 May, remains in force; no new PHEIC found
state: WHO determined the Bundibugyo Ebola epidemic in DR Congo and Uganda a public health emergency of international concern on 17 May (WHO). Africa CDC said on 15 Nov the outbreak is still not under control (Al Jazeera). Searches to 21 Nov found no new PHEIC in the past 30 days and no pandemic emergency, so a PHEIC in effect keeps Watch.
for_you: Check FCDO travel advice and UKHSA guidance before travel to DR Congo and neighbouring countries.
rubric_hit: PHEIC in effect (Ebola, since 17 May) = Watch
basis_detail: WHO (PHEIC and IHR Emergency Committee decisions)
basis_by: WHO (PHEIC and IHR Emergency Committee decisions)

sources.title: WHO — Ebola epidemic in DR Congo and Uganda determined a PHEIC
Al Jazeera — Africa CDC says Ebola outbreak in DR Congo still not under control

why: A WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) or 'pandemic emergency' is the top official global health alarm.
drivers: Outbreak spread, IHR Emergency Committee decisions.

rubric.alert: A new PHEIC declared in the past 30 days, or a pandemic emergency declared.
rubric.watch: A PHEIC in effect, or an IHR Emergency Committee convened.
rubric.normal: No PHEIC in effect other than long-running polio.
